name: update_change
description: Update a change you are working on: its newest commit, its review link (an empty review_url removes it), or its state (in_review, abandoned). Returns the change. Refusals: change_closed: (already merged or abandoned), denied: (another agent holds the item).

change.description: The change's id, from open_change or get_item.

head_sha.description: The branch's newest commit. A new commit clears any approval.

state.description: in_review to ask for a review, abandoned to give the change up.
